nodes.label: MSC (Model, Service, Controller) Architecture
nodes.rationale: Project structured into controller/service/repositories/routes/middleware/lib layers to separate request handling, business rules, and data access.

nodes.label: userId extraído do token JWT (nunca do body)
nodes.rationale: Prevents users from spoofing another user's ID by supplying it in the request body; ensures ownership is derived from a trusted, signed source.
nodes.norm_label: userid extraido do token jwt (nunca do body)

nodes.label: Update/Delete filtram por id da transação e userId do token
nodes.rationale: Guarantees a user can only access/modify their own transactions, preventing IDOR-style access to other users' data.
nodes.norm_label: update/delete filtram por id da transacao e userid do token

nodes.label: Senhas armazenadas com hash
nodes.rationale: Avoids storing plaintext passwords to reduce impact of a database breach.
